notes.title: Upgrading from Beta 2.0 to Beta 3.0
notes.notes:
The game Springy a Bounce Adventure has received a massive update in its DEMO, the update contains:

- Main menu with only “New Game” if the player has never played it, and with “Continue” when finishing the first map and getting at least 1 star.
- V-sync function added to the Options Menu and enabled by default in-game (V-sync helps prevent texture breaks and alleviates GPU usage by limiting FPS to Monitor frequency.)
- Mixed camera function, where it works with mouse movement or respective buttons and works automatically when staying 5 seconds without moving manually. Note: When disabling this option in the Options Menu, the camera will only work manually.
- Level selector map now with only 1 demo map much more complete and with new background image.
- First level reworked once again, including a new transparent water system, new shadow system and a more complete lighting system.
- The First Level now also features sounds in your environment and on moving or animated objects.
- Added 4 camera distance levels.
- The main character Springy now has animations and sounds when performing actions.
- The NPC now has sounds.
- Boss now has sounds when performing actions.
- New update in battle with Boss, battle scripts have been improved.
- New resolutions and screen aspects added.
- The game received more optimizations like the LOD system and can now run on some even weaker computers.
- Repair of several and several BUGS.

Note: Remembering that even to get 3 stars in a level, it is necessary to get all the oranges, jewels and finish the level by entering the portal, all at once, if you do only one of the objectives or two of them, you will only get 1 star or 2 respectively.

Note 2: I don't intend to update the DEMO anymore, because the game is well advanced in development, and messing with the Demo can delay the project.

Note 3: If you find any BUG or error, please inform.

*Heads up!!! Important notice: If you don't appear to update, uninstall the game and go to the store page and put the option "download game" and it will be updated in your library.*

Springy wishes you all an incredibly awesome gaming experience!!!

notes.title: Upgrading from Beta 1.0 to Beta 2.0
notes.notes:
The game Springy a Bounce Adventure has received an update in its DEMO, the update contains:

- Options menu with new options added.
- Improved navigation in menu buttons.
- Level selector map now supports button navigation and has new artwork added.
- Option to see the amount of stars to open new levels.
- It is now necessary to finish the previous level to open the next one, even if the player has the necessary amount of stars (all levels must be finished with at least 1 star).
- First level reworked, including new items, minor scenery changes and improved boss fight.
- Added character shapeshifting (now it changes shape when climbing scalable objects, such as vertical stairs), the implement has opened doors for future functions, wait.
- Improved adaptive gravity at the race level.
- New resolutions and screen aspects added.
- The game received optimization and can now run on some weaker computers.
- Fixed some BUGS.

Note: To get 3 stars in a level, it is necessary to get all the oranges, jewels and finish the level by entering the portal, all at once, if you do only one of the objectives or two of them, you will only get 1 or 2 star respectively.

Note 2: This is the last update of the DEMO of the game, now the focus will be on finishing the same, and with that, the fix of other BUGs and new implements will only be added in the final version of the game, thank you very much for understanding.

Note 3: If you find any BUG or error, please inform.

*Attention!!! Important news: If you don't appear to update, just go to the store page and put the option "download game" and it will be updated in your library.*

Springy wishes you all an amazing gaming experience!!!
